blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A lone bettor from Malabanban Sur, Candelaria, Quezon won the P10-million Lotto 6/42 jackpot in Saturday night’s draw. In an advisory on Sunday, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said the bettor correctly guessed the winning combination of 16-40-07-18-41-03.
